builds.build: supersession reader only (newest copy per id, death records)

method: Each build is the same seed and world through the same harness. The pre-amendment build is `git archive e6d1bcc`; the reader-only build is that archive with organica/candidates.py and organica/sleep_selection.py from the working tree; the amended build is the working tree itself. Values reproduced in separate processes.
attribution_limit: The measurement decomposes the reader step from the amendment step and no further. Inside the amendment step the guards act on both the current-cycle key set and the store; this figure does not separate those two effects.
consequence: Gate 13's verdict does not move: the amended asserted coverage is far below the threshold, so the gate still fires. Gate 13 artifacts recorded before the amendment describe the pre-amendment engine.
